message.subject: You won ₱1,000,000
message.body: Congratulations! Your address was selected for ₱1,000,000. Claim within 10 minutes. Follow the link and confirm your account password to release the prize.
message.safety_label: FICTIONAL PRACTICE • No real links or credentials

intro.title: Morning light
intro.speaker: player
intro.text: My eyes slowly open. Morning light fills my room. Then I hear it... my phone is buzzing.

intro.title: Where is my phone?
intro.speaker: player
intro.text: I turn toward the sound and reach across the bed. There it is. A new notification lights up the screen.

intro.title: A new email
intro.speaker: player
intro.text: I unlock my phone. A message from Prize Desk is waiting for me.

intro.title: One tempting promise
intro.speaker: player
intro.text: I open the message. It asks me to follow a link and confirm my account password to claim the prize.

intro.title: What if it is real?
intro.speaker: player
intro.text: A million pesos. For a moment, I imagine it. Before checking who sent the offer, I tap Claim Prize.

intro.caption: And this is how it began…

amani.caption: Her phone has no signal. Her friends receive messages that appear to be hers. Someone is using the trust attached to her identity.

liza.caption: A familiar voice asked for a payment. It went to the wrong account. The attacker used a voice she had reason to recognize.

staff.caption: Her name approved a request for a confidential student list. She never approved it. The attacker borrowed her authority.

classmate.caption: A free offer led to lost account access. The attacker turned something appealing into a request for something private.

clues.title: Who sent it?
clues.note: The display name sounds official, but this address does not independently establish who is offering a prize.

clues.title: Where does it lead?
clues.note: The destination requests an account password. Do not use this link to verify the message that supplied it.

clues.title: Why the rush?
clues.note: The deadline pressures you to act before checking. Urgency is a clue to examine, not proof by itself.

clues.title: What is promised?
clues.value: ₱1,000,000 from a selection I did not enter
clues.note: An unexpected reward plus a password request is a reason to stop. A prize should not need your account password.

wake.title: That morning, again
wake.text: I am back beside my phone. This is practice: I can pause, go back, or leave at any time.

inbox.title: A message arrives
inbox.text: Tap the notification on the phone to open the message. Opening it here is not the same as following its link.

message.title: The promise is back
message.text: I can inspect the request before deciding. Tap Inspect to reveal details, or choose a response.

inspect.title: Look beyond the promise
inspect.text: Tap a detail to examine it. Save at least three different clues to the Evidence Binder. Nothing here opens a real website.

binder.title: Evidence Binder
binder.text: These are the clues I saved for this practice. I can return to the message and choose a response.

respond.title: What will I do?
respond.text: Checking a message does not make its link safe. Choose an action that protects the account.

failure.title: Got you.
failure.text: This practice shows the trap, not an automatic infection. Following a prize link can lead to a page that asks for secrets. Opening the email alone did not cause that. Check the sender, destination, pressure, and reward claim before acting. The attacker designed the deception; this is not your fault.

review.title: A safer choice — now find the evidence
review.text: You avoided the link. Before finishing this practice, inspect and save three clues so you can explain what made the request unsafe.

success.title: My account stays mine
success.text: I kept my password private and did not follow the prize link. My evidence explains the warning signs. Familiar isn't verified.

summary.title: Your controls, your pace
summary.text: Tap a message to read it. Use Inspect to examine details. Save useful clues to the Evidence Binder. Choose a response after checking. Back revisits a step; Menu lets you pause or leave. Replay Intro and Replay Tutorial are in Settings. You can start Module 1 from Lessons; its existing learning requirements still apply.

responses.label: Ignore the request
responses.feedback: I leave the request unanswered and keep my credentials private.

responses.label: Report as suspicious
responses.feedback: I use the practice report control. No message or report is sent outside this simulation.

responses.label: Delete the message
responses.feedback: I remove the practice message without following its link. My saved clues remain in the Binder.

ui.pause_text: Nothing advances while this menu is open.
ui.reveal_text: Tap to reveal the full dialogue
ui.replay_note: Replay only — your learning progress and completion status will not change.
